<translate>
<!--T:6-->
The '''Demon Eye''' is the relic of King [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah|Gomah]], the strongest world boss of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]]. Worn in the '''Head Tech''' Curios slot, it multiplies all your stats by '''×1.5''', but it slowly drains you and corrupts your heart.
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting it == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Gomah drops the Demon Eye 2% of the time when he is defeated (see [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses|World Bosses]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== While you wear it == <!--T:9-->

<!--T:10-->
* All your stats are multiplied by '''×1.5'''.
* Every second it drains '''2%''' of your max ki. Once your ki is empty, it drains '''2%''' of your max health instead. This drain is never lethal.
* It lowers your [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] by 1 every 10 seconds.
* The longer you wear it, the bigger you grow: up to ×1.5 size over 5 minutes, with your hitbox and reach growing too. You snap back to your normal size the moment it comes off.
</translate>

<translate>
== Knocking it off == <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
'''3''' hits from behind within 10 seconds knock the Demon Eye off your forehead. The same rule works against Gomah himself during his fight.
</translate>
